errors.text_span: This plot illustrates the percentage of immigrants in Germany born abroad who have settled in Germany, categorized by age, from 2010 to 2020.
errors.evidence: The chart purpose is about the share of employed individuals by migration background, not immigration percentages or time periods like 2010 to 2020.

errors.text_span: The y-axis represents the percentage of immigrants in Germany born abroad who have settled in Germany, ranging from 0% to 85% with tick labels spaced every 10%.
errors.evidence: The y-axis represents the share of employed individuals in percentage (0% to 100%), not specifically immigrants, and the range is incorrect (should be 0% to 100%).

errors.text_span: x-axis ... with tick labels spaced every 5 years
errors.evidence: The x-axis ticks are spaced every 10 years, not 5.

errors.text_span: A black solid line represents the percentage of immigrants without migration background who have settled in Germany, starting at approximately 75% at age 20 and decreasing to approximately 30% at age 70.
errors.evidence: The black line starts at 60% at age 20, peaks at 85% at age 30, and decreases to 10% at age 70, not 30%.

errors.text_span: A light gray dashed line represents the percentage of immigrants in Germany born abroad who have settled in Germany up to 2009
errors.evidence: The gray line represents 'in Deutschland geboren' (born in Germany), not immigrants up to 2009. The line style is also solid, not dashed.

errors.text_span: A blue dotted line represents the percentage of immigrants in Germany born abroad who have settled in Germany starting from 2010
errors.evidence: The blue line represents 'zugewandert seit 2010' (immigrated since 2010), but the line is solid, not dotted. The description also misrepresents the data values.

errors.text_span: beginning at approximately 10% at age 20 and decreasing to approximately 5% at age 70
errors.evidence: The dark blue line starts at 40% at age 20, peaks at 50% at age 30, and decreases to nearly 0% at age 70, not 5%.

errors.text_span: A light gray dashed line represents the percentage of immigrants in Germany born abroad who have settled in Germany up to 2009, beginning at approximately 60% at age 20 and decreasing to approximately 30% at age 70.
errors.evidence: The light blue line (not gray) represents 'zugewandert bis 2009' (immigrated up to 2009), starting at 35% at age 20 and decreasing to 10% at age 70, not 30%.
The description omits the y-axis label ('Anteil Erwerbstätige in %') and the correct range (0% to 100%).
The description does not mention the gray line's trend (similar to black but with smaller fluctuations).
The description does not mention the plateau of the black line (constant at 85% from age 30 to 60).
The description does not mention the light blue line's range (60% to 80% from age 20 to 60).
The chart does not represent data from 2010 to 2020; it represents employment share by age and migration background.

errors.text_span: This plot illustrates the percentage of immigrants in Germany born abroad who have settled in Germany
errors.evidence: The description introduces an interpretation not supported by the chart (immigrants settling in Germany). The chart is about employment share, not settlement.

errors.text_span: A black solid line represents the percentage of immigrants without migration background who have settled in Germany
errors.evidence: The phrase 'immigrants without migration background' is contradictory and unclear.
The description oversimplifies the trend of the black line, which actually decreases to 10% at age 70, not 30%.

errors.text_span: The y-axis represents the percentage of immigrants in Germany born abroad who have settled in Germany, ranging from 0% to 85% with tick labels spaced every 10%.
errors.evidence: The sentence is overly verbose and repetitive, reducing readability.
